model_annotation: The image displays three donut charts comparing the number of enterprises, the number of persons employed, and turnover by industry, construction, trade, and services in 2021, with data sourced from NACE Rev. 2 and presented as absolute values. Each chart is divided into four sectors corresponding to the categories listed in the legend at the bottom: Industry (yellow), Construction (light blue), Trade (red), and Other Services (dark blue). The first chart, "NUMBER OF ENTERPRISES," shows that Other Services accounts for 61% (19.0 million), Trade for 19% (5.9 million), Construction for 12% (3.7 million), and Industry for 8% (2.4 million). The second chart, "NUMBER OF PERSONS EMPLOYED," indicates that Other Services employs 51% (80.2 million), Trade 19% (29.5 million), Construction 9% (13.4 million), and Industry 21% (33.0 million). The third chart, "TURNOVER," shows that Other Services has 31% (9.9 trillion), Industry 33% (10.6 trillion), Trade 31% (9.8 trillion), and Construction 6% (1.9 trillion). All three charts have labels inside each sector showing the percentage and the absolute value, and the sectors are arranged in a clockwise direction. The chart titles are positioned above each donut, and the overall layout is a horizontal arrangement of the three charts.
